programme.title: Schedule
programme.description: This schedule is indicative and will be refined closer to the competition. Final times will be communicated to registered participants by email.

reglement.title: Rules
reglement.description: The full rules (official document) will be sent to every registered participant. This page summarizes the key points.

categoryDescriptions.planeur: Distance and precision flying, bungee or towed launch.
categoryDescriptions.voltige: Compulsory and free figures, scored by a jury on an FAI grid.
categoryDescriptions.droneRacing: Timed races on a marked circuit, single elimination.
categoryDescriptions.libre: Open to any other discipline, subject to organizer approval.

scoring.heading: Scoring
items: Each event is scored by a jury of at least 3 judges.
The final score is the average of the scores, excluding the best and worst.
Ties are broken by a fly-off.
Any breach of safety rules results in a penalty or disqualification.

safety.heading: Safety
items: Identifying vest or armband mandatory in the flying area.
Aircraft inspected by a technical marshal before each session.
Flying area and public area strictly separated by marked boundaries.
Track officials' instructions must be followed at all times.
